name: zinterp_object3d_default_render_action
description: zInterp_Object3D::DefaultRenderAction resolves a node display-instance user-data pointer and runs scrolling-texture update once per frame.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c59e0 validates using the incoming ECX node as the action-callback argument, fetching user data through zClass_Class::gwNodeGetUserData, and tailing into zModel_Instance::UpdateScrollingTexturesIfNeeded with the recovered model instance pointer.
The native smoke verifies that the callback updates a model instance's scrollingTextureFrameTick through zModel_Instance_UpdateScrollingTexturesIfNeeded.
